objective: Make the first Loadout screen self-explanatory: a newcomer can see that they put a card into a Slot and then press Play, with authoritative legal-state presentation and readable portrait interaction.
non_goals: No gameplay, timing, input-authority, or legal-action change
No merger with mobile safe-bounds implementation
required_evidence: First-view player-language instruction and source-of-truth UI behavior update
Focused presentation probe for selected, legal, invalid, danger, Slot-destination, and Play/Undo/Help hierarchy states
Architecture boundary and Test Automation independent validation before UI ownership release
